optimization_analysis: Three changes reduce LM cost: (1) The flight_phase predicate (CONTAINS 'Approach' OR 'Landing') is a structured field in incidents.csv — moving it into the initial SCAN_TABLE FILTER eliminates non-approach/landing incidents before any document scanning occurs. (2) Both structured side-tables (environment_attributes and events) are joined before SCAN_DOCS/SEM_FILTER rather than after, so only incidents that already satisfy the flight_conditions and result-label constraints are fetched as documents and sent to the LM — this can cut the document set substantially. (3) The two sequential SEM_FILTERs (positive cause check then negative cause exclusion) are merged into one, halving the number of LM calls per surviving document. Semantics are unchanged: the combined prompt enforces both the inclusion and exclusion criteria simultaneously.

optimized_semantic_plan.program:
approach_incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, local_time_of_day, flight_phase])
  -> FILTER(local_time_of_day = '1201-1800' AND (flight_phase CONTAINS 'Approach' OR flight_phase CONTAINS 'Landing'))
)
environment_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, environment_attributes.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER(attribute = 'flight_conditions' AND value IN ('IMC','Marginal','Mixed'))
)
result_events := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(event_type = 'result' AND label IN ('Flight Crew Executed Go Around / Missed Approach','Air Traffic Control Issued New Clearance'))
)
structured_candidates := JOIN(left=approach_incidents, right=environment_records, join_type=inner, condition=approach_incidents.incident_id = environment_records.incident_id)
structured_candidates_with_events := JOIN(left=structured_candidates, right=result_events, join_type=inner, condition=structured_candidates.incident_id = result_events.incident_id)
semantic_candidates := (
  structured_candidates_with_events
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=structured_candidates_with_events.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports where weather or visibility explicitly caused the go-around, missed approach, or new clearance. Exclude reports where traffic spacing, runway occupancy, or aircraft equipment was the primary cause of that outcome.", {text})
)
semantic_candidates
-> GROUP_BY([flight_conditions:value, recorded_result=CASE label WHEN 'Flight Crew Executed Go Around / Missed Approach' THEN 'go_around_or_missed_approach' ELSE 'new_clearance' END], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id)})
